goal: Count to five: one number for each thing, the last number is how many; moving things does not change how many; five as a row and as dots.
cover: Bear in a baker's apron at the foot of a big old beech tree with a round hollow and a little ladder, holding up a basket of golden rolls; Owl and her four fluffy owlets lean out of the hollow, each owlet reaching for one roll; Squirrel and Hedgehog beside Bear, counting the rolls on their paws; warm afternoon light in the forest.
